Workers record every failure and always run the middleware release hook (#12)

ThreadBackend, ProcessBackend's worker and the queue entrypoint each carried
their own copy of compute/record/hooks, and all three caught only Exception
and wrote RUNNING outside the try. One _compute_and_record now runs in all
three: a BaseException is recorded FAILED then re-raised, a failing store
write (RUNNING, COMPLETED or FAILED) still ends in on_error, and exactly one
of after_compute / on_error follows every before_compute. The three hook
loops become one _call_hooks.
